stories.title: Leafs finish ugly homestand with another loss
stories.summary: Anthony Stolarz watched from the crease as his teammates battled for 60 hard minutes.

stories.title: Levi, McDavid help Oilers top Maple Leafs
stories.summary: Devon Levi made 19 saves for his first NHL shutout and Connor McDavid extended his season-opening point streak to 21 games as the Edmonton Oilers downed Toronto 1-0 to hand the Maple Leafs their sixth straight home loss Saturday.

stories.title: Carney seeks Grey Cup repeat with Elks this time
stories.summary: Malik Carney will see familiar faces on the other side of the football Sunday.

stories.title: Elks, Alouettes stage final Grey Cup walkthroughs
stories.summary: Cody Fajardo isn't going to mess with a winning formula, not even during Grey Cup week.

stories.title: Fifth Canadian soldier has died after fire in Wainwright, CAF says
stories.summary: A fifth Canadian soldier has died from injuries sustained during a training exercise last month at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta.

stories.title: Major fire tears through Mayerthorpe, at least 3 businesses lost
stories.summary: At least three businesses were lost following a major overnight fire that burned through the town centre in Mayerthorpe, the mayor said.

stories.title: Alouettes looking for better result in Grey Cup
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes safety Nate Beauchemin has been experiencing a homecoming of sorts this week even though the Alouettes are officially the visiting team when they face the Edmonton Elks in Sunday's Grey Cup.

stories.title: CFB Wainwright incident casts spotlight on reserve pay disparities: former bureaucrat
stories.summary: Four soldiers died and 39 others — including several reservists — were injured when a fire suddenly overtook a training area at CFB Wainwright last month.

stories.title: Alberta changing royalty system to encourage oilsands production, new investment
stories.summary: Alberta is rolling out a new resource royalty program it says is aimed at incentivizing new investment and development in the oilsands by offering guaranteed, predictable rates.

stories.title: Ben Major to serve as referee at Grey Cup contest
stories.summary: Ben Major will serve as the referee for the Grey Cup on Sunday.
